The only TT failure is noise: 315 nV/√Hz simulated against a 280 nV/√Hz limit. The likely cause is 1/f noise from the small-area input pair. There is also a robustness risk: the tail device M5 has only 0.05 V of saturation margin, so it will drop into triode at the ss/cold or low-supply corners.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Cut 1/f noise with a larger, higher-gm/Id input pair (gm/Id 18, L 2 um, more tail current). Lower the NMOS mirror Vdsat (gm/Id 15) to give M5 about 0.1 V more margin. Also correct the noise, slew, CMRR and PSRR models using this simulation."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),
    "L_in":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "I_tail":  (28e-6, 20e-6, 50e-6),
    "gmid_p":  (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),
    "L_p":     (0.8, 0.4, 1.5),
    "gmid_n":  (15.0, 10.0, 18.0),
    "L_n":     (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),
    "I2":      (140e-6, 90e-6, 200e-6),
    "Cc":      (1.1e-12, 0.7e-12, 2.0e-12),
    "kz":      (1.6, 0.8, 3.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It, I2, Cc = p["I_tail"], p["I2"], p["Cc"]
    Id1 = It / 2

    # NMOS input pair; high gm/Id lowers Vgs, leaving more headroom for the tail
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Id1, vds=0.55)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], Id1, vds=1.0)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], I2, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias mirror family shares gm/Id and L; high gm/Id gives low Vdsat on the tail
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], iref, vds=0.65)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], It, vds=0.25)
    m6 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], I2, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M8", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "y", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "y", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "y", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    n.R("Rz", "y", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m6.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + 1e-15
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * cl + Cc * (C1 + cl)) / (2 * PI)
    pmirror = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (1.0 / m7.gm - Rz)) if abs(1.0 / m7.gm - Rz) > 1e-9 else 1e15
    ph = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmirror))
    ph += math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(z))) * (1 if z < 0 else -1)
    # empirical: sim slew ~0.76 * It/Cc (Cc plus parasitics at node y)
    slew = min(0.76 * It / Cc, I2 / (cl + Cc))
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I2)
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    # Thermal noise plus 1/f noise.
    # Calibrated to the previous run (gm/Id 16, L 1.5 um, 12 uA per side gave 315 nV).
    # 1/f noise scales roughly as 1/sqrt(gate area); area ~ Id*L^2/(gm/Id) at fixed inversion -> heuristic.
    gn = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300 * (2 / 3) * 2 / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    th = math.sqrt(gn)
    area_rel = (Id1 / 11.75e-6) * (p["L_in"] / 1.5) ** 2 * (p["gmid_in"] / 16.0) ** 1.5
    flick = 3.1e-7 / math.sqrt(max(area_rel, 1e-3))
    noise = math.sqrt(th ** 2 + flick ** 2)
    cmrr = db(2 * gm1 * a1 / m5.gds) - 20
    psrr = db(a1 * a2)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": ph, "slew": slew,
               "power": power, "swing": swing, "noise_1k": noise,
               "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr}
```
